mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods (name, price, supplier_id, description, remark) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{supplierId}, #{description}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO goods (name, price, supplier_id, description, remark) VALUES
(#{item.name}, #{item.price}, #{item.supplierId}, #{item.description}, #{item.remark})
mapper.select: SELECT g.*, s.name AS supplier_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN supplier s ON g.supplier_id = s.id WHERE g.id = #{id} AND g.is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM goods WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND name = #{name} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET name = #{name}, price = #{price}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, description = #{description}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE goods SET name = CONCAT('del_', id, '_', name), is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
